title: Update on Project Wolbachia and Reason for Spike of Dengue Cases in First Quarter 2019
what_it_is: Update on Project Wolbachia and Reason for Spike of Dengue Cases in First Quarter 2019

sections.label: Dengue cases first quarter 2019
sections.summary: NEA reported 2,200 dengue cases in the first quarter of 2019, more than three times the same period in 2018 but below 2013 and 2014 epidemic years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The National Environment Agency (NEA) has reported 2,200 cases of dengue in the first quarter of 2019.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This was more than three times compared to the same period in 2018, but below the number of cases reported during the epidemic years of 2013 and 2014.

sections.label: Phase 1 field study results
sections.summary: The Phase 1 field study ran from October 2016 to December 2017 and achieved 50% suppression of the urban Aedes aegypti mosquito population.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The Phase 1 field study was conducted from October 2016 to December 2017 and a 50% suppression of the urban Aedes aegypti mosquito population was achieved.

sections.label: Phase 2 field study suppression
sections.summary: The Phase 2 field study, from April 2018 to January 2019, saw dengue vector population suppression of 70% to 80%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As a result, the Phase 2 field study, conducted from April 2018 to January 2019, saw a significantly higher level of dengue vector population suppression of 70% to 80%.

sections.label: Phase 3 field study aims
sections.summary: Phase 3 aims to determine how suppression can be sustained through seasonal fluctuations and over a larger area, and the number of male Wolbachia-Aedes mosquitoes required.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For the Phase 3 field study, as I have said, what we aim to do is to determine how the suppression can be sustained through the seasonal fluctuations of the Aedes aegypti mosquito population and also over a larger study area and in order to determine the number of male Wolbachia-Aedes mosquitoes that is required to sustain the suppression that has been achieved in Phase 2.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: That is why, for Phase 3, we have actually expanded the study site, the same study sites but to a larger area of 1.6 to 2.2 times.

sections.label: Wolbachia complements vector control
sections.summary: The Wolbachia technology is meant to complement and enhance existing vector control strategies, not to replace them.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Another point that I would like to highlight is that the Wolbachia technology is meant to complement and enhance our existing vector control strategies and not to replace them.

sections.label: Question on fogging effectiveness
sections.summary: A question asks if the Ministry can explain whether fogging is useful and effective, given understanding that mosquitoes will eventually become resistant to some chemicals used.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: One, can the Ministry explain if this fogging is useful and effective because I have some understanding that the mosquitoes will eventually become resistant to some of the chemicals being used.

sections.label: Source reduction against mosquito breeding
sections.summary: The primary and most effective method is source reduction, preventing mosquito breeding rather than fogging and misting.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The most effective and primary method really is source-reduction, that is, preventing mosquito breeding rather than fogging and misting.

sections.label: Wolbachia technology trials and production
sections.summary: Wolbachia technology is still under development, with trials and field studies, and Phase 3 results must be evaluated before larger-scale deployment, while production efficiency is being improved.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have said, the Wolbachia technology is still under development and, at the moment, we are undertaking trials and field studies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, we will have to evaluate the results of Phase 3 of the field study carefully and rigorously before we decide if we should deploy the technology on a larger scale.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But at the same time, in terms of production of the Wolbachia-Aedes mosquitoes, we are actually looking, as I have alluded to also in my reply, at production and release through automation, improving the productivity and production efficiency as well as the quality of the Wolbachia-Aedes mosquitoes produced at the production facility.
